planner_heuristic_statement: An audit finding of present corrective work is legitimate if and only if a requirement originated from an authentic user instruction or specification baseline, has not undergone complete subsequent supersession, and remains missing, partially implemented, unenforced, or incorrectly represented in today's deterministic executable runtime, workflows, or active configuration. Normative implementation reality is established solely by executable code and deterministic execution paths—not by specification prose, filenames, or self-reported completions. Historical evidence must be evaluated through a strict three-tier epistemic chain: verified historical facts (exact commits, diffs, persisted runtime artifacts) -> explicit semantic interpretations (intent, failure cause, requirement scope) -> normative truth decisions (surviving status, supersession classification, active defects).
